title: Seollal 2027 in Korea: How to Plan Your Trip
summary: Visiting Korea during Seollal? Learn how to plan intercity travel, check what’s open, and enjoy a quieter Seoul.

slides.title: Book Early For Seollal
slides.voice: Seollal 2027 packs Korea’s trains. Book early.

slides.title: Reserve Intercity Trips
slides.voice: Intercity trains and express buses sell out early. Book ahead, or stay in one city.

slides.title: Check What’s Open
slides.voice: Small family-run restaurants may close, but convenience stores, cafes and chains usually stay open. Check Naver Map.

slides.title: Enjoy A Quieter City
slides.voice: Seoul’s roads and subways can feel quieter. Stay in one city and enjoy the change.
